dataset_family: ADNI (ADNI-3 phase): 233 MCI and 305 healthy adults selected to be free of neuropsychiatric symptoms; data obtained September to December 2021
method_family: Imaging group comparison and correlation. FreeSurfer regional MRI volumes and partial-volume-corrected flortaucipir tau-PET SUVR in predefined ROIs; MANOVA of MCI with vs without NPS; Spearman correlations; linear regression of NPI scores on imaging.
what_it_shows: De Lucia et al., Int Psychogeriatr 2023; 35(11):623-632. The PDF title, authors and DOI 10.1017/S104161022200117X match the block. In ADNI-3, 26.1% of the MCI group had NPI depression. MCI participants with ANY neuropsychiatric symptom had smaller orbitofrontal and posterior cingulate volumes than those without, and no difference in regional tau-PET. A sub-analysis correlated the five most frequent NPI domains, depression among them, with orbitofrontal and posterior cingulate volumes and found no significant associations. Each domain is scored as frequency x severity, 0-12. The result is reported only as 'data not shown'.
why: PARTLY, weakly. The only depression-specific result is a null correlation in MCI between the informant-rated NPI depression domain score and two regional brain volumes. That fits the brain-measure part of the severity sub-clause ('continuous severity scores fail to track brain measures'). LIMITS. (1) 'Data not shown': no coefficient, n or analysis subset (all MCI, or MCI+ only) is printed. (2) Only two ROIs (three volumes) were tested, and they were chosen because they differed by any-NPS status. (3) The measure is an NPI domain (informant, frequency x severity), not a depression scale, and it is 0 for the roughly 74% of MCI participants without depression. (4) The authors' limitations paragraph says they 'did not perform a qualitative analysis of the different types of neuropsychiatric symptoms' and leaves correlating volumes with the frequency and severity of individual signs to future studies. This sits uneasily with the unreported sub-analysis and lowers its weight. (5) Depression is never tested against the tau PET the study collected; the tau regression uses total NPI. Total NPI burden was independently predicted by posterior cingulate volume, but that is global NPS, not depression. There is no conversion outcome. The first clause cannot be tested because the healthy adults were selected to have no neuropsychiatric symptoms. REJECTION GROUND ANSWERED. P-770 was removed in the 2026-08-11 bulk G4 revert of legacy re-appends. The generic grounds were that members do not measure depression, or do not test severity against structural or functional brain measures. The PDF shows that it scores NPI depression and reports a null depression-volume correlation, so the generic ground is factually wrong for this paper. The evidence it offers remains unquantified. INDEPENDENCE. The dataset family is ADNI. No current supporter is ADNI, but ADNI is the family of P-26, the study the row cites outside the supporter list as the counter-evidence, and P-770 would count once with any other ADNI supporter. No shared cohort with the other three candidates (Bologna, HABS-HD, LBC1936). The method family (MRI/PET imaging group comparison and correlation) is the same broad family as P-643's. No shared authors (Federico II Naples group). Not a preprint.

quotes.quote: A total of 233 MCI and 305 healthy comparisons were selected from the ADNI-3 cohort.
We also included data from 305 (174 female) HA participants who did not show occurrence of neuropsychiatric symptoms as assessed by means of the Neuropsychiatric Inventory (see below).
For each psychopathological domain, a total score is provided by multiplying frequency and severity scales (range: 0–12).

Spearman’s correlation analysis between the most frequent behavioral symptoms in this cohort (depression, irritability, sleep disturbances, apathy, and agitation) and orbitofrontal cortex and bilateral posterior cingulate cortex volumes did not show signiﬁcant associations (data not shown).
MANOVA on normalized PVC Flortaucipir uptake did not show any signiﬁcant differences between the two groups in all the predeﬁned regions (see Table 3).
The model built with regional Flortaucipir uptake in the predeﬁned regions as independent predictor was not signiﬁcantly associated with NPI scores (data not shown).

We did not perform a qualitative analysis of the different types of neuropsychiatric symptoms, but further studies could consider investigating the correlation of regional gray matter volumes with frequency and severity of different clinical signs in MCI.
